name: zclass_window_add_clear_polygon_vertex
description: zClass_Window::gwWindowAddClearPolygonVertex validates the window node, appends a capped clear-polygon vertex to the active clear polygon, forces the stored vertex z/depth value to 100.0f, and reports full-buffer errors.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass window/source-cluster pass because the surrounding class helpers and layout-sensitive clear-polygon operations should be byte-reviewed together.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x44fbd0 validates the null node, null data, and wrong-class old error paths; the clear-polygon index and vertex count caps at four entries; the high-bit in-progress flag on the polygon vertex count; storage of x and y from the supplied zVec3; forced stored z/depth value 100.0f; and masked vertex-count increment.

The native smoke verifies successful vertex append, high-bit count update, forced z/depth value, close-polygon handoff to span occlusion, full polygon buffer and full vertex buffer errors, and null node, null data, and wrong-class return codes.
